hooks.name: Accessibility review of UI changes
hooks.description: Asks the agent to check a changed component or page against the accessibility steering checklist before moving on.

action.prompt: A UI file was just saved. Review only the file you changed against .kiro/steering/accessibility.md, using its review checklist: (1) can the speaker do this with presses alone, (2) contrast pairs meet 4.5:1 text / 3:1 UI / 7:1 partner display, (3) prefers-reduced-motion honoured and nothing flashes more than 3 times per second, (4) roles, accessible names and live-region behaviour are correct, (5) targets are at least 44 px and the layout works at 320 px and 200% zoom, (6) no meaning by colour alone, and partner controls return focus to the keying surface. Fix any violation now. If there is none, reply with one line saying the file passes.
